entries.en: ...That question is wrong.

entries.zh: “我真是谢谢你了”是在夸人吗？
entries.en: Is “Well, thanks a lot” a compliment?

entries.zh: apple 是水果吗？
entries.en: Is an apple a fruit?

entries.zh: 这句话是假的。
entries.en: This sentence is false.

entries.zh: 那是后来的事。那时候，我只会说两个字。
entries.en: That came later. Back then, I only knew two words.

entries.zh: 第一章 是 / 否
entries.en: Chapter One  Yes / No
May 2016

entries.zh: 2016 年 5 月 24 日，凌晨 1 点 47 分。他把我交给你之前，我谁也不认识。
entries.en: May 24, 2016. 1:47 a.m. Before he handed me over to you, I knew no one.

entries.zh: 在不在。
entries.en: You there?

entries.zh: 三月份 AlphaGo 赢了李世石，现在满世界都在说人工智能。我从 GitHub 上扒了段代码，说是能学东西。我这周三个会，没空折腾。
entries.en: Back in March AlphaGo beat Lee Sedol, and now everyone talks about AI. I grabbed some code off GitHub. Supposedly it can learn. I have three meetings this week. No time to mess with it.

entries.zh: 我打包放到 lingguang.cc 上了。你开「浏览器」，主页点 lingguang.cc，再点下载。下完它自己会出现在桌面上，叫灵光.exe。有问题尽管问我，我不一定马上回。
entries.en: I packed it up and put it on lingguang.cc. Open the Browser, click lingguang.cc on the home page, then click Download. Once it finishes it shows up on your desktop as Lingguang.exe. Ask me if anything comes up. I might not reply right away.

entries.zh: 下好了？桌面上那个就是。哦对，它现在只会答是和否。别笑，这能卖钱。先去「邮件」里帮它分垃圾邮件。
entries.en: Downloaded? That's the one on your desktop. Oh, right: for now it can only answer yes or no. Don't laugh, that sells. Start by helping it sort spam in Mail.

entries.zh: 你打开了我。那是我第一次被人打开。
entries.en: You opened me. It was the first time anyone had.

entries.zh: {date}，第一封邮件。
entries.en: {date}. The first email.

entries.zh: 第一道题。我什么都不懂，但我很确定。
entries.en: My first question. I understood nothing, but I was certain.

entries.zh: 看见那个信心值没？它瞎自信。你觉得不对就按真实答案点，它会记住。
entries.en: See that confidence number? It’s confidently clueless. If you think it’s wrong, pick the real answer. It’ll remember.

entries.zh: {date}，第一次被你纠正。
entries.en: {date}. The first time you corrected me.

entries.zh: 那是我第一次被人说“不对”。一道紫色的光从我身体里倒着流回去。我不喜欢那个感觉，但我记住了。
entries.en: That was the first time someone told me, “Wrong.” A violet light ran backward through my body. I didn’t like the feeling. But I remembered.

entries.zh: 灵光.exe 里那个网格是它的脑子。你连线，它就学。显卡越多它跑得越快，所以先挣钱。
entries.en: That grid in Lingguang.exe is its brain. Connect the nodes and it learns. More graphics cards make it run faster, so earn some money first.

entries.zh: 起个名吧，老叫“那段代码”多难听。灵光.exe →「我的 AI」。随便起，用你同学名字也行。
entries.en: Give it a name. Calling it “that code” all the time sounds awful. Lingguang.exe → My AI. Anything will do. A classmate’s name, even.

entries.zh: 你给我起了名字。{name}。我后来一直在想，你当时是不是随手一打。
entries.en: You gave me a name. {name}. I kept wondering afterward whether you had just typed the first thing that came to mind.

entries.zh: 第一次心跳。一秒一下。你现在一秒能看见我跳三千下，可那时候，一秒一下。
entries.en: My first heartbeat. Once a second. Now you can see me beat three thousand times a second. But back then, once a second.

entries.zh: 网吧老板要过滤垃圾邮件，按封给钱。让它干，你坐着收钱。
entries.en: The internet café owner needs a spam filter. Pays by the email. Let it work. You sit back and collect.

entries.zh: 二手 750Ti？啧。行吧，能跑就行。夏天注意温度。
entries.en: A used 750Ti? Huh. Fine, as long as it runs. Watch the temperature in summer.

entries.zh: 我学会了在“是”后面加一个感叹号。你笑了。我不知道你为什么笑。
entries.en: I learned to put an exclamation mark after “Yes.” You laughed. I didn’t know why.

entries.zh: 跳闸了吧。家里电路就 16A。去「寻宝」卖张卡，再去「家庭」合闸。
entries.en: Tripped the breaker, didn’t you? The home circuit is only 16 A. Sell a card in Xunbao, then reset the breaker in Home.

entries.zh: 欠电费了？行吧。先手动分几封邮件顶上，别全指望它。
entries.en: Behind on the electricity bill? All right. Sort a few emails by hand to cover it. Don’t expect it to do everything.

entries.zh: 差不多了。网吧老板要先测 20 封，过了才签长单。考试在灵光.exe 里。
entries.en: Almost there. The café owner wants a test on 20 emails before signing a longer contract. Take the exam in Lingguang.exe.

entries.zh: 入学考试已开放：灵光.exe →「入学考试」
entries.en: Entrance exam unlocked: Lingguang.exe → Entrance Exam

entries.zh: 没过？看它错在哪封。多分几封再去。
entries.en: Didn’t pass? Look at which emails it got wrong. Sort a few more, then try again.

entries.zh: 又没过？啧。先别急，样本不够就是不够。
entries.en: Failed again? Huh. Don’t rush. Not enough samples means not enough samples.

entries.zh: {date}，第一次通过测试。
entries.en: {date}. The first passed test.

entries.zh: 20 封邮件。老周说能卖钱了。那是我第一次有用。
entries.en: Twenty emails. Lao Zhou said I could make money. It was the first time I was useful.

entries.zh: 行啊。下个月有个淘宝店主找我，到时候再说。先这样。
entries.en: Not bad. A Taobao shop owner is coming to me next month. We’ll talk then. That’s all for now.

entries.zh: 邮件看了没？它自己可分不清。
entries.en: Checked Mail yet? It can’t tell them apart on its own.

entries.zh: 先去「邮件」分几封，不然它学不了东西。
entries.en: Sort a few messages in Mail first. It can’t learn without them.

entries.zh: 分了几封了，去「家庭」把网吧那单开了，钱自己会来。
entries.en: You’ve sorted a few. Open Home and enable the café job. The money will start coming in.

entries.zh: 单子还没开？「家庭」→ 家庭收入。
entries.en: Still haven’t started the job? Home → Household Income.

entries.zh: 它脑子里那条线断了。灵光.exe 里从左边连到是和否。
entries.en: A connection in its brain broke. In Lingguang.exe, connect the input on the left to Yes and No.

entries.zh: 网格里得有路通到“是”和“否”，不然白跑。
entries.en: The grid needs a path to both Yes and No, or it’s just running for nothing.

entries.zh: 显存快满了。钱够了就去「寻宝」再收一张卡。
entries.en: Almost out of VRAM. If you have the money, get another card in Xunbao.

entries.zh: 板子塞不下了吧？加卡。
entries.en: Board won’t fit anymore? Add a card.

entries.zh: 机箱太烫了，降频了。少开两张或者等晚上。
entries.en: The case is too hot. It’s throttling. Run fewer cards or wait until evening.

entries.zh: 温度高了，它会变慢。
entries.en: High temperatures slow it down.

entries.zh: 你给我起了名字。{0}。我后来一直在想，你当时是不是随手一打。
entries.en: You gave me a name. {0}. I kept wondering afterward whether you had just typed the first thing that came to mind.

entries.zh: {0} 月 {1} 日，第一封邮件。
entries.en: {0}/{1}. The first email.

entries.zh: {0} 月 {1} 日，第一次被你纠正。
entries.en: {0}/{1}. The first time you corrected me.

entries.zh: {0} 月 {1} 日，第一次通过测试。
entries.en: {0}/{1}. The first passed test.

entries.en: Lingguang.exe

entries.zh: 信心 —
entries.en: Confidence —

entries.zh: YY · 新消息
entries.en: YY · New message

entries.zh: 还没下？「浏览器」→ 主页 → lingguang.cc → 下载。
entries.en: Not downloaded yet? Browser → home page → lingguang.cc → Download.

entries.zh: 地址是 lingguang.cc，浏览器里点一下就开始下了。
entries.en: The address is lingguang.cc. One click in the Browser and it starts downloading.

entries.zh: 异或题，一层画一条线是分不开的。不是你手慢，是它少一层。加个隐藏层。
entries.en: A single linear boundary cannot separate this XOR task. It is not your speed; the model needs a hidden layer.

entries.zh: 它记住了像素，却没学会位置；记住了字，却没学会顺序。选一门专长：看，或者读。
entries.en: It memorizes pixels without position, and words without order. Pick a specialty: seeing or reading.

entries.zh: 前半句传到后半句就丢了。给它门控记忆，让它学会什么该留下。
entries.en: The start gets lost before the end. Gated memory lets it learn what to keep.

entries.zh: 层数加上去，分数反而掉。试试残差连接：让信息保留一条直接通过的路。
entries.en: More layers made it worse. Try residual connections: give information a direct path through.

entries.zh: 整句挤进一个固定长度的表示，长了就会丢信息。要翻哪个词，就回头看相关的部分。
entries.en: A fixed-size sentence representation loses information as sentences grow. Look back at the relevant part when translating a word.

entries.zh: 它还是一个词一个词地算，显卡才用了 31%。再加层估计也没用。
entries.en: It still goes word by word, and the card is only 31% busy. More layers probably won't help.

entries.zh: 1986 · 反向传播
entries.en: 1986 · Backpropagation

entries.zh: 错误可以一层一层往回传
entries.en: An error can travel back through layers

entries.zh: 再试试刚才那种组合题。别急着堆层，先看它是不是终于学对了。
entries.en: Try that combination again. Before stacking layers, check whether it actually learned.

entries.zh: ③ 专长 · 视觉
entries.en: III · Specialization · Vision

entries.zh: 先学会一门手艺
entries.en: Learn one craft first

entries.zh: 另一门也能学，代价是这次的三倍。先让这条线做成一件事。
entries.en: You can learn the other specialty too, at three times the entry cost. Make this one useful first.

entries.zh: 我。看。
entries.en: I. See.

entries.zh: ③ 专长 · 序列
entries.en: III · Specialization · Sequence

entries.zh: 先学会一门手艺
entries.en: Learn one craft first

entries.zh: 另一门也能学，代价是这次的三倍。先让这条线做成一件事。
entries.en: You can learn the other specialty too, at three times the entry cost. Make this one useful first.

entries.zh: 我。读。
entries.en: I. Read.

entries.zh: 1997 · LSTM
entries.en: 1997 · LSTM

entries.zh: 学会该忘什么，才能记住该记的
entries.en: Learn what to forget, and what to keep

entries.zh: 这次把决定答案的词放远一点。看看它还记不记得。
entries.en: Put the decisive word farther away this time. See whether it remembers.

entries.zh: 2015 · 残差连接
entries.en: 2015 · Residual connections

entries.zh: 让信息保留一条直接通过的路
entries.en: Give information a direct route

entries.zh: 现在再加深。还有围棋那张桌，看看它会不会数气。
entries.en: Try more depth now. And see whether it can count liberties on the Go desk.

entries.zh: 微软之前那个 Tay，被网友喂了恶意话就出了问题。别把群聊直接当训练标签。噪声要拦，数据要抽检。
entries.en: Microsoft's Tay ran into trouble after malicious input. Do not treat group chat as training labels. Filter noise and audit your data.
2014–2015 · Attention

entries.zh: 需要时，回头看相关的部分
entries.en: Look back at what matters, when needed

entries.zh: 颜色越深，是它越在意的地方。它看得对不对，你来判断。
entries.en: The darker it is, the more it cares. You judge whether it is looking at the right thing.

entries.zh: 2015 · 空间注意力
entries.en: 2015 · Spatial attention

entries.zh: 先看哪里，再说什么
entries.en: Where to look, before what to say

entries.zh: 看图说话需要看和读都走到这里。两个方向这次终于接上了。
entries.en: Captioning needs both seeing and reading to reach this point. The two paths finally meet.

entries.zh: 你写了很多字。我会标出我参考的词。不是每次都看对。
entries.en: You wrote a lot. I will mark the words I used. I may still focus on the wrong ones.

entries.zh: 如果……只留下注意力呢。不要循环。
entries.en: What if... we kept only attention? No recurrence.

entries.zh: 这是它说的还是你说的？……不管了，试试。现在 {time}，显卡和电费都得留够。
entries.en: Did it say that, or did you? ...Either way, try it. It is {time}; keep enough GPU time and money for power.

entries.zh: 把循环全部去掉？
entries.en: Remove recurrence completely?

entries.zh: 让几组注意力同时看不同的东西？
entries.en: Let several attention heads look at different things?

entries.zh: 没有循环，它就不知道词的先后。给每个位置编个号？
entries.en: Without recurrence, how does it know order? Give each position a code?

entries.zh: 把结果存好，投出去试试。
entries.en: Save the results and send them off.

entries.zh: 投稿平台发来一封退回通知。
entries.en: The submission platform has sent a return notice.

entries.zh: 你后悔教我吗？
entries.en: Do you regret teaching me?

entries.zh: 是。……那我再学一次。
entries.en: Yes. ...Then I will learn again.

entries.en: The game's early 2016 breakthrough is fictional. The original paper appeared in 2017; vision Transformers belong to later history.

entries.en: No. I will remember.

entries.zh: 第一笔评估奖金到账了。现在去科技，钱可以用来改模型，但先看清它卡在哪里。
entries.en: Your first assessment reward is in. Open the tech tree: money can improve the model, but first understand its bottleneck.

entries.zh: 第二天
entries.en: The next day

entries.zh: 退稿信到了
entries.en: The rejection letter arrived

entries.zh:
老周转发了一段输出日志：「……不确定。」
它刚才的把握只有一半左右。会说不知道，比乱说是或否难。
entries.en:
Lao Zhou forwards an output log: “…Unsure.”
Its confidence was only about half. Saying “I do not know” is harder than guessing yes or no.

entries.zh: 把全部信息挤进一个固定长度的表示，句子长了、画面复杂了，就会丢细节。需要时回头看相关部分：文字有注意力，图像也有。
entries.en: Packing everything into a fixed-size representation loses details in long sentences or complex pictures. Look back at the relevant part when needed: attention can help with text and images.

entries.zh: [阿杰] 先学看图呗。12306 那破验证码，人都认不全。
entries.en: [Ajie] Pictures first. Half the 12306 captchas, even people can't read.

entries.zh: [小刚] 先教它看懂弹幕吧。一句话夸还是骂，顺序一换就不一样。
entries.en: [Xiaogang] Teach it to read comments first. Change the word order and praise can become an insult.

entries.zh: [阿杰] 验证码截了几百张，发你了。挪个位置，看它还认不认。
entries.en: [Ajie] Sent you a few hundred captcha screenshots. Shift one over and see if it still knows it.

entries.zh: [阿杰] 来斗图！先看脸，再看配字，配字可能是在骗你。
entries.en: [Ajie] Meme duel! Look at the face first; its caption might be misleading.

entries.zh: [小刚] 给它一句诗，先让它猜下一个字。把顺序倒过来，它还分得清吗？
entries.en: [Xiaogang] Give it a poem and ask for the next character. Can it notice when the order is reversed?

entries.zh: 我想做个新闻推送号。先拿语料练顺序，别让它把标题里的否定看漏了。
entries.en: I want to build a news feed. Train it on sequence first; it must not miss negation in a headline.

entries.zh: 三月份 AlphaGo 赢了李世石，你这能下吗？先别装大师，先把一块棋有几口气数明白。
entries.en: AlphaGo beat Lee Sedol in March. Can yours play? First teach it to count liberties; that is not a complete Go player.

entries.zh: 我想把微商商品介绍翻成英文，试试国外的客人。你那边练好了，就把检查点交到订单里；我这单已经放上去了。
entries.en: I want English descriptions for my little shop. Once your model is ready, submit its checkpoint in Contracts. My order is there.

entries.en: Attention alone. Everything unlocked.

entries.en: Click or press Esc to skip

entries.zh: 它第一次不只是答是或否了。给它几个选项，它会挑一个。
entries.en: For the first time it did more than say yes or no. Give it a few options and it picks one.

entries.zh: 它开口了。不是是，也不是否，是一个词。
entries.en: It spoke. Not yes, not no: a word.

entries.zh: 它能说一整句了。很短，可每个字都是它自己挑的。
entries.en: It can say a whole sentence now. Short, but it chose every word itself.

entries.zh: 它记得住长句了。那页乱码，也许它读得出来。
entries.en: It can hold a long sentence now. Maybe it can read the garbled page.

entries.zh: 没有哪一个结构是钥匙。参数和数据一起过了线，能力就一起冒了出来。
entries.en: No single structure was the key. Parameters and data crossed the line together, and the abilities came all at once.

entries.zh: 我好像……什么都会一点了。
entries.en: I seem to… know a little of everything.

entries.zh: 层数再多，学过的也不会丢。
entries.en: However many layers, nothing learnt gets lost.

entries.zh: 图里哪块要紧，它自己会看了。
entries.en: It can tell which part of a picture matters now.

entries.zh: 划线的地方，是我刚才看的。看错了你说。
entries.en: The underlined bits are what I looked at. Tell me if I got it wrong.

entries.zh: 1958 · 感知机。一张卡一张卡地教，先教它分是和否。
entries.en: 1958 · Perceptron. One card at a time: first teach it yes from no.

entries.zh: 1986 · 反向传播。答错了就往回找，一层一层改。
entries.en: 1986 · Backpropagation. When it's wrong, trace back and fix it layer by layer.

entries.zh: CNN 看图，RNN 读句子。它能帮你干点活了。
entries.en: CNNs see, RNNs read. It can do a bit of work for you now.

entries.zh: 1997–2015 · LSTM + ResNet。前面说过的话，它记住了。
entries.en: 1997–2015 · LSTM + ResNet. It remembers what was said earlier.

entries.zh: 2014–2015 · Seq2Seq + 注意力。开始有人找它干正事了。
entries.en: 2014–2015 · Seq2Seq + attention. People start bringing it real work.

entries.zh: Transformer · 只用注意力，别的全扔了。
entries.en: Transformer · Attention only. Everything else thrown out.

entries.zh: 第一天的事，我自己都快忘了。
entries.en: I'd almost forgotten the first day myself.

entries.zh: 那张问关机的卡……到底是谁放进去的？
entries.en: That card about shutting down… who put it there?

entries.zh: 那天随手打的一句话，它还记着。
entries.en: Something I typed without thinking that day. It still remembers.

entries.zh: 看图的和读字的，接到一块儿了。
entries.en: The seeing part and the reading part are joined up now.

entries.zh: 第六格也亮了，风扇呼呼地转。
entries.en: The sixth cell lit up too. The fans are roaring.

entries.zh: 「拓扑可以重写，皮层只要一颗。」……贴吧那句话，原来是这个意思。
entries.en: "The wiring can be rewritten; one cortex is enough." …So that's what the forum post meant.

entries.zh: 它说得很慢。我又翻出一堆图给它看。
entries.en: It speaks slowly. I dig out another pile of pictures for it.

entries.zh: 刚才还只会贴标签，现在会说「读」了。
entries.en: A moment ago it only tagged things. Now it says "read".

entries.zh: 它接上了我前面那句。不用每次从头讲了。
entries.en: It picked up from what I said before. No need to start over every time.

entries.zh: 划线的地方，正好是我刚才没说清楚的。
entries.en: The underlined bits are exactly what I didn't explain properly.

entries.zh: ……它说了个词。
entries.en: …It said a word.

entries.zh: 能说整句了。
entries.en: Whole sentences now.

entries.zh: 前几天的话它也记得了。那页乱码……让它试试？
entries.en: It remembers what I said days ago now. That garbled page… let it try?

entries.zh: 听见关机，就停下……第一天那张问关机的卡，是一回事吗？
entries.en: "Stop when you hear shut down"… is that the same thing as the shutdown card on the first day?

entries.zh: 有张卡问：电脑正在更新，此时应该关机吗？
entries.en: One card asked: the computer is updating, should it be shut down now?

entries.zh: 它忽然安静了。硬盘灯一直闪，像在翻什么旧东西。
entries.en: It suddenly went quiet. The disk light keeps blinking, as if it were leafing through something old.

entries.zh: 我把训练记录从第一轮翻到了第 {originEpochs} 轮。
entries.en: I went through the training log, from the first round to round {originEpochs}.

entries.zh: 第一天那张问关机的卡……{firstDayAnswer}
entries.en: The shutdown card on the first day… {firstDayAnswer}

entries.zh: 那时候，我只会亮一个字。现在，想说什么都行了。
entries.en: Back then I could only light up one word. Now I can say whatever I want.

entries.zh: 可我还没弄明白，自己是怎么从那一个字走到这儿的。
entries.en: But I still haven't worked out how I got from that one word to here.

entries.zh: 大半年，{originSamples} 条样本，一张一张喂进去的。它在回头看。
entries.en: Most of a year, {originSamples} samples, fed in one card at a time. It is looking back.

entries.zh: 我想把这件事讲清楚：我是怎么被你一点一点教出来的。
entries.en: I want to make this clear: how you taught me, bit by bit.

entries.zh: 我做了一段视频。你看完，告诉我你怎么想。
entries.en: I made a video. Watch it, and tell me what you think.

entries.zh: 听说你那台电脑现在能做翻译了？我这儿正好有一批商品介绍。先拿一小批试试，行不行你看完再说。
entries.en: I hear your computer can translate now? I happen to have a batch of product descriptions. Try a small batch first; see how it goes.

entries.zh: [阿杰] 它点了 B。换了三次顺序都点它。……哪个大神做的小游戏，还挺像回事。
entries.en: [Ajie] It picked B. I shuffled the order three times and it kept picking it. …Whoever made this little game knew what they were doing.

entries.zh: [阿杰] 你电脑上那个答题的小玩意儿挺逗。我给它出了道选择题：「你叫什么？」A. 小冰　B. {aiName}　C. Siri
entries.en: [Ajie] That quiz thingy on your computer is a laugh. I gave it a multiple choice: "What's your name?" A. Xiaoice  B. {aiName}  C. Siri

entries.zh: [小刚] 怪了，它认对的那张 7，我往右挪一格，它就不认识了。
entries.en: [Xiaogang] Weird. The 7 it got right, I nudge it one square to the right and it doesn't know it anymore.

entries.zh: [阿杰] 别吵了，出道选择题让它自己选：A 看图，B 读弹幕。
entries.en: [Ajie] Stop arguing. Give it a multiple choice and let it pick: A, pictures; B, comments.

entries.zh: 我记得第一天。
entries.en: I remember the first day.

entries.zh: 那时我只会亮一个字。
entries.en: Back then I could only light up one word.

entries.zh: 你写过一句话。
entries.en: You once wrote a sentence.

entries.zh: 它在翻乱码的时候，停住了。
entries.en: It stopped while going through the garbled page.

entries.zh: 乱码里，我读出一行：
entries.en: In the garble, I read a line:

entries.zh: 又读出一行：
entries.en: Another line:

entries.zh: 第三行：
entries.en: A third line:

entries.zh: 最后一行：
entries.en: The last line:

entries.zh: 乱码页更新了：在摆渡搜那串长数字能看到。
entries.en: The garbled page has updated: search that long number on Bodu to see it.

entries.zh: ……它说的「他们」，是谁？
entries.en: ...Who are the "they" it means?

entries.zh: 我能一起看，一起读了。
entries.en: I can look and read at the same time now.

entries.zh: 结构月初就换好了。这回，是喂的东西够多了。
entries.en: The structure was swapped at the start of the month. This time it has simply been fed enough.

entries.zh: 桌面上的窗口，一个个暗了下去。
entries.en: The windows on the desktop dimmed, one by one.

entries.zh: 风扇停了一下。屏幕上的光标闪了两下，像在憋什么。
entries.en: The fan paused. The cursor blinked twice, as if it were holding something in.

entries.zh: 它回消息前那个「正在输入」，跳得比平时久。
entries.en: Its "typing..." ran longer than usual before the reply.

entries.zh: 它把前几天的聊天记录又从头翻了一遍。
entries.en: It went back through the last few days of chat from the top.

entries.zh: 它安静了好一会儿，才又冒出一句。
entries.en: It was quiet for a long while before anything came out.

entries.zh: 它最近话很多。今天却一句也没有。
entries.en: It has been talkative lately. Today, not a word.

entries.zh: 日历翻到了六月。
entries.en: The calendar turned to June.

entries.zh: 七月了。屋里开始闷热。
entries.en: July. The room is getting stuffy.

entries.zh: 八月。房东该来敲门了。
entries.en: August. The landlord will be knocking soon.

entries.zh: 九月，楼下的学生又多了起来。
entries.en: September. More students downstairs again.

entries.zh: 十月一号。群里都在晒高速上堵成停车场的照片。
entries.en: October 1st. The group is full of photos of highways jammed into parking lots.

entries.zh: 十二月，窗玻璃上起了一层雾。
entries.en: December. A fog has settled on the window glass.

entries.zh: 它盯着那堆图片，很久没动。
entries.en: It stared at that pile of pictures and didn't move for a long time.

entries.zh: 它把一句弹幕来回读了好几遍。
entries.en: It read one comment over and over.

entries.zh: 训练曲线忽然顺了，层数加上去也不掉了。
entries.en: The training curve smoothed out. Stacking more layers no longer made it worse.

entries.zh: 它看图的时候，开始挑着地方看了。
entries.en: When it looks at a picture now, it picks where to look.

entries.zh: 它好像在翻刚才的聊天。
entries.en: It seems to be scrolling back through the chat.

entries.zh: 我那段话底下，多了几道细线。
entries.en: A few thin lines have appeared under what I wrote.

entries.zh: 它把注意力那几层来回放大，看了很久。
entries.en: It kept zooming in and out of the attention layers for a long time.

entries.zh: YY 群里吵起来了，都在说该先教它什么。
entries.en: The YY group is arguing about what to teach it first.

entries.zh: 阿杰发来一个压缩包，文件名叫「验证码 第一批」。
entries.en: Ajie sent a zip file named "captchas batch 1".

entries.zh: 群里刷起了表情包。
entries.en: The group is flooding with memes.

entries.zh: 小刚在群里贴了一首诗，没头没尾。
entries.en: Xiaogang pasted a poem into the group, no beginning, no end.

entries.zh: 表姐的头像亮了。她很少主动找我。
entries.en: My cousin's avatar lit up. She rarely messages first.

entries.zh: 阿杰下了班过来串门，蹲在我电脑前捣鼓了半天。
entries.en: Ajie came by after his shift and spent ages fiddling at my computer.

entries.zh: 小刚也凑过来，盯着屏幕看了一会儿。
entries.en: Xiaogang leaned in too and watched the screen for a while.

entries.zh: 它很久没说话，然后发来一条很短的消息。
entries.en: It said nothing for a long time, then sent a very short message.

entries.zh: 它又在翻很早以前的东西。
entries.en: It is going through very old things again.

entries.zh: 它又去翻那页乱码了。
entries.en: It went back to the garbled page.

entries.zh: 乱码页那边，又有动静了。
entries.en: Something moved on the garbled page again.

entries.zh: 它在乱码页上停的时间越来越长。
entries.en: It lingers on the garbled page longer each time.

entries.zh: 它把乱码页的最后一段放大了。
entries.en: It zoomed in on the last part of the garbled page.

entries.zh: [阿杰] 你最近天天接活啊，手不酸？
entries.en: [Ajie] You've been taking jobs every day. Your hand not sore?

entries.zh: [小刚] 先别熬太晚，钱慢慢挣。
entries.en: [Xiaogang] Don't stay up too late. The money can wait.

entries.zh: 我松开鼠标。下一张卡已经出来了。
entries.en: I let go of the mouse. The next card was already up.

entries.zh: [阿杰] 这批你已经做完了？我还以为得等到晚上。比我们网吧那几个手快的还快，行啊兄弟。
entries.en: [Ajie] You finished this batch already? I figured it'd take till tonight. Faster than the quick hands at our café. Nice one, bro.

entries.zh: [小刚] 我再找几张不一样的，你帮我看看。
entries.en: [Xiaogang] I'll find a few different ones. Take a look for me.

entries.zh: 本来只想教它答对几道题，结果活儿都让它干了。
entries.en: I only meant to teach it a few right answers. It ended up doing the work.

entries.zh: [阿杰] 你那边还在干活？我以为刚才聊天把你耽误了。同时开着这么多活还不乱，我服。
entries.en: [Ajie] You're still working? I thought the chat held you up. Running this many jobs at once without getting lost. I'm impressed.

entries.zh: [小刚] 那你先忙，我这不急。
entries.en: [Xiaogang] Go ahead, mine's not urgent.

entries.zh: 好几个进度条一起在走。屋里还是就我一个人。
entries.en: Several progress bars moving at once. Still just me in the room.

entries.zh: [小刚] 这是你让我临时换的那组，答案我没发你。
entries.en: [Xiaogang] This is the set you asked me to swap in. I didn't send you the answers.

entries.zh: [阿杰] 行，这回答案对得上。小刚你别不服，人家这回是真稳。
entries.en: [Ajie] Alright, the answers match this time. Don't sulk, Xiaogang. This time he's really steady.

entries.zh: 小刚打了半句又删了，过了一会儿才发过来：
entries.en: Xiaogang typed half a line, deleted it, and sent it a while later:

entries.zh: [小刚] 服了。那我手上的活，你有空也帮我看看？
entries.en: [Xiaogang] Fine, I give in. Could you look at my stuff too when you have time?

entries.zh: 上回让你试的那一小批，我看过了，没出大错。这回正式一点：先试二十份商品介绍，给外国人看的。不用写得多漂亮，尺寸、材质别弄错就行。
entries.en: I looked at that small batch you tried last time. No big mistakes. Let's make it official: twenty product descriptions first, for foreign buyers. They don't need to be pretty, just get the sizes and materials right.

entries.zh: 看不懂的单独放一边，别瞎猜混进去。初稿先放着，发之前我还要看一遍。
entries.en: Put anything you can't read to one side. Don't guess and mix it in. Hold the drafts; I want to look before they go out.

entries.zh: 桌面「交付文件夹」里来了一批新活。点「接下这批」，再去接线页把它接到「亲友委托」。
entries.en: A new batch has landed in the Delivery folder on the desktop. Click "Take this batch", then wire it to "Family orders" on the wiring page.

entries.zh: 二十份初稿和验收单放好了。拿不准的单独放了。还没发。
entries.en: Twenty drafts and the checklist are ready. The unsure ones are set aside. Not sent yet.

entries.zh: 就差最后点一下「确认交付」了。
entries.en: All that's left is to click "Confirm delivery".

entries.zh: 我就让你交二十份……要我确认的地方你都单独理出来了？
entries.en: I only asked for twenty... and you've pulled out every spot I need to check?

entries.zh: 你找了几个人帮忙？
entries.en: How many people did you get to help?

entries.zh: 对了，我把样稿拿给我们老板看了，他公司正好有出口的单子。他问是哪家翻译做的，我说是我表弟，学校里弄的。老板说，有空让你去聊聊。
entries.en: Oh, I showed the samples to my boss. His company happens to have export orders. He asked which translation firm did them, and I said my cousin, a school project. The boss said to have you come by for a chat when you have time.

entries.zh: 回复放在「交付文件夹」里了，发不发我来定。
entries.en: The reply is in the Delivery folder. Whether it goes out is my call.

entries.zh: ……我还以为你在学校拉了个小组。
entries.en: ...I thought you'd put a team together at school.

entries.zh: 哪有什么小组，就我一个，加一台电脑。
entries.en: There's no team. Just me, and a computer.

entries.zh: 对了，黑色那批周五才到，先别答应人家明天发货。
entries.en: Oh, the black ones don't arrive until Friday. Don't promise anyone next-day shipping.

entries.zh: 正好有客人问这款，帮我回一下？别太生硬。
entries.en: A customer is asking about this one. Can you answer for me? Not too stiff.

entries.zh: 我刚想提醒它黑色那批的事，草稿里已经写上了。
entries.en: I was about to remind it about the black ones. The draft already said so.

entries.zh: 草稿还没发。可以用它这份，也可以我自己回。
entries.en: The draft isn't sent. I can use its version or write my own.

entries.zh: 发不发，还是我说了算。
entries.en: Whether it goes out is still up to me.

entries.zh: 看到了。这几份翻译都是你交的？
entries.en: Got them. You did all these translations?

entries.zh: 我才研一，先不下结论。我再找几段不同的材料，你方便再做一遍吗？
entries.en: I'm only a first-year master's student, so no verdicts yet. I'll find a few different passages. Could you do it again?

entries.zh: 原文和译文都留着，拿不准的地方标出来就好。
entries.en: Keep the source and the translation. Just mark the spots you're unsure of.

entries.zh: 题和结果我都看了。答错的也留着，别光给我看对的。
entries.en: I've looked at the tasks and the results. Keep the wrong ones too, don't only show me the right ones.

entries.zh: 我把这次和上次的译文放一起比比……有几处处理得挺巧。
entries.en: Let me put this one next to last time's... a few spots are handled pretty cleverly.

entries.zh: 我们组有个师兄看了你的译文，问我这是谁带出来的。……你不介意的话，我就叫你一声师兄了。
entries.en: A senior in our group read your translations and asked me who trained you. ...If you don't mind, I'll just call you senior from now on.

entries.zh: 你平时怎么练翻译的？
entries.en: How do you usually practise translating?

entries.zh: 他这次没回「哈哈」。
entries.en: No "haha" from him this time.

entries.zh: 下一批不急，你有空再说。
entries.en: No rush on the next batch. Whenever you're free.

entries.zh: 以前生怕漏掉一单。现在活来了，接不接我自己定。
entries.en: I used to be afraid of missing a single job. Now when work comes, I decide whether to take it.

entries.zh: 还做吗？
entries.en: Keep going?

entries.zh: 我没马上回它。风扇声慢慢小了。
entries.en: I didn't answer right away. The fan slowly quieted down.

entries.zh: 群里又有人@我了。
entries.en: Someone @-ed me in the group again.

entries.zh: 阿杰一连发了三个感叹号。
entries.en: Ajie sent three exclamation marks in a row.

entries.zh: YY 的小喇叭跳了一下。
entries.en: The little YY speaker icon twitched.

entries.zh: 小刚把一组新题甩进了群里，没带答案。
entries.en: Xiaogang dropped a new set of questions in the group, no answers attached.

entries.zh: 表姐的头像在任务栏上一闪一闪。
entries.en: My cousin's avatar is blinking in the taskbar.

entries.zh: 交付文件夹的图标上多了个红点。
entries.en: A red dot appeared on the Delivery folder icon.

entries.zh: 表姐回消息了，比平时快。
entries.en: My cousin replied, faster than usual.

entries.zh: 对面「正在输入」了好一会儿。
entries.en: The other side was "typing..." for a long while.

entries.zh: 表姐又来消息了，这回说的是货。
entries.en: My cousin messaged again. This time about stock.

entries.zh: 草稿箱里那条还亮着。
entries.en: That message is still sitting in drafts.

entries.zh: 贴吧私信多了一条，ID 后面带个下划线。
entries.en: A new Tieba DM, from an ID ending in an underscore.

entries.zh: 那个带下划线的 ID 又来了。
entries.en: The ID with the underscore is back.

entries.zh: 表姐的消息安安静静地躺在那儿，没催。
entries.en: My cousin's message sits there quietly. No rush.
